output.reason: No approved unit answers this. The question asks what to say before quoting the cost of a medical visit. The available disclaimers (U-RX-EDU-001-09, U-RX-EDU-002-07, E-SOP-09, E-SOP-10) and the read-word-for-word instruction (E-SOP-08) cover only drug and specialty pharmacy pricing, such as a 30-day supply or a specialty supply at a pharmacy. None covers the cost of a medical visit.
